# Multiplication on an integer field
age > {10 * 3}

# Division that comes out whole
age = {60 / 2}

# Subtraction
age < {20 - 2}

# Unary minus
age <= {-1}

# * binds more tightly than +
balance > {1000 + 0.5 * 2}

# A decimal quotient on a float field
height > {3.6 / 2}

# A decimal result on an integer field is rejected
age = {10 / 4}

# A quotient with no finite decimal form is rejected
balance = {1 / 3}

# Division by zero is rejected
age > {1 / 0}

# :: binds most tightly: 2 * (3::DAYS)
due = {TODAY + 2 * 3::DAYS}

# Subtracting a negated duration adds it
due = {END_OF_WEEK - -1::DAYS}

# A duration divided by an integer
due = {TODAY + 6::BUSINESS_DAYS / 2}

# Parentheses group durations of different units
last_seen > {NOW - (1::HOURS + 30::MINUTES)}

# A date plus hours is a timestamp
last_seen >= {TODAY + 9::HOURS}

# ... which a date field rejects
due = {TODAY + 9::HOURS}

# Time minus time is rejected
last_seen > {NOW - TODAY}

# A bare duration is rejected
due > {5::DAYS}
